purchase_motivation.primary: Turn school years that would otherwise be recorded separately into one structured, year-by-year keepsake.
purchase_motivation.secondary: Make changes across a child's school years easier to look back on through repeated profile, photo and reflection prompts.
purchase_motivation.user_problem: School-year details, pictures and small milestones are easy to leave scattered or unrecorded.
purchase_motivation.desired_change: Create one organized record that visibly connects early school years with later grades.
purchase_motivation.why_buy: The album combines grade-specific sections with recurring photo and writing prompts, so the value is not merely a notebook but a structured multi-year record.
risks: The footage proves the blank structure, not that a family used it or felt a particular emotion.
No exact complete grade range or page count is verified.

evidence: The same album is turned from early-grade to later-grade sections.
Readable headings and prompt areas directly verify the printed structure.
gaps: No filled example proves accumulated real-world use.
No complete contents view verifies every included grade.

evidence: Distinct grade headings, photo/drawing areas, profile fields, favorites, activities and reflection prompts create multiple non-repeated information states.
gaps: Some later-page text is soft or partially obscured during page turns.

evidence: The cover explicitly frames the album as a place for a child's keepsakes.
Early-to-later grade structure supports a restrained idea of looking back across time.
gaps: No child, parent, family interaction, filled page, revisit behavior or emotional reaction.

evidence: Rainbow cover, colorful section designs and visible page volume create ownership appeal.
gaps: No premium lifestyle, gift or shelf-display scene.

basis: The strongest purchase meaning is directly supported by multiple grade headings and distinct prompt types.
The strategy explicitly limits Emotion to interpretation of the printed keepsake structure rather than claiming observed family response.
The Information score clearly leads on both demand and material support.

hook_hypothesis.purchase_meaning: One structured album can hold school memories from early years into later grades.
hook_hypothesis.promise_created: The viewer will see how the book organizes different school years and what can be recorded in each.
hook_hypothesis.payoff_due: Readable early- and later-grade headings, followed by photo and prompt fields in the same album.
hook_hypothesis.why_first: The early-to-later-grade contrast delivers the reason to care before a general product tour; a cover-only opening would identify the object but delay its multi-year value.
hook_hypothesis.risk: The contrast must use only clearly readable grade states and must not imply filled memories, exact total coverage or a real child's experience.

required_proof.claim: The album provides separate sections for multiple school years, from early school into later grades.
required_proof.action: Turn from an early-grade spread to later-grade spreads
required_proof.result: Distinct headings such as Preschool/1st Grade and 9th/11th Grade appear
required_proof.confirmation: Hold at least one early and one later heading until each is readable

required_proof.claim: Each visible school-year section is structured for personal details and school memories.
required_proof.action: Point to and frame printed prompts
required_proof.result: Name/signature, height/weight, teacher, friends, favorites, subjects and reflection lines are visible
required_proof.confirmation: Use a small set of non-duplicate fields and exit when labels are read

required_proof.claim: The album includes spaces for pictures and drawings.
required_proof.action: Reveal the framed spaces on open pages
required_proof.result: School-picture and self-drawing boxes are visible
required_proof.confirmation: Hold the labeled boxes long enough to read

required_proof.claim: The album preserves a family's real memories over time.
required_proof.owner: A real filled album used by a family
required_proof.action: Insert records/photos and revisit them later
required_proof.result: Accumulated completed pages and a real revisit experience
required_proof.confirmation: Show the real users and completed record

information_state_plan.new_understanding: This is one album designed to connect early school years with later grades.
information_state_plan.voice_or_caption_job: Translate the visible grade contrast into a restrained benefit: one place for school years, without claiming real use.
information_state_plan.enter_when: Video opens on a readable early-grade state or a tightly paired early/later contrast.
information_state_plan.exit_when: The viewer has read both an early and later grade heading and understands the time span.
information_state_plan.delete_cost: The opening falls back to product identity and loses the main purchase meaning.

information_state_plan.new_understanding: The object is specifically a School Memories Album for a child's keepsakes.
information_state_plan.voice_or_caption_job: Name the product after the value-led contrast, using only the cover wording.
information_state_plan.enter_when: The multi-year promise has been created.
information_state_plan.exit_when: Cover title and keepsakes line are readable.
information_state_plan.delete_cost: The viewer may understand the format but not the product identity.

information_state_plan.new_understanding: The multi-year promise is carried by actual separated grade sections in the same book.
information_state_plan.voice_or_caption_job: State that visible sections progress through multiple school years; do not state an unverified exact total.
information_state_plan.exit_when: Several distinct grade headings establish progression; additional headings that add no new time-span meaning are omitted.
information_state_plan.delete_cost: The hook would become an unsupported montage rather than a proven structure.

information_state_plan.new_understanding: The pages are not generic blanks: they organize repeatable profile and school details.
information_state_plan.voice_or_caption_job: Convert the field list into user meaning: a consistent snapshot of each school year.
information_state_plan.exit_when: One representative early-grade and one later-grade field set are readable; avoid listing every prompt.
information_state_plan.delete_cost: The album's organizing mechanism would remain vague.

information_state_plan.new_understanding: Pictures, drawings, favorites and reflections can occupy different kinds of memory spaces.
information_state_plan.voice_or_caption_job: Explain breadth without claiming completed memories.
information_state_plan.exit_when: Photo/drawing plus one distinct favorites/reflection state have been read.
information_state_plan.delete_cost: The viewer may reduce the product to a basic school profile form.

information_state_plan.new_understanding: The restrained emotional value is being able to look back across changing school-year snapshots, not an observed family reaction.
information_state_plan.voice_or_caption_job: Use possibility language such as 'a place to keep each year's details together'; avoid 'your child will love it' or relationship outcomes.
information_state_plan.enter_when: The structure has already been proven.
information_state_plan.exit_when: The emotional interpretation has been stated once and anchored to visible early/later pages.
information_state_plan.delete_cost: The plan remains accurate but more functional; no evidence integrity is lost.

information_state_plan.new_understanding: The viewer can own one complete, substantial album containing many designed sections.
information_state_plan.voice_or_caption_job: Summarize the proven value: multiple school-year snapshots in one album.
information_state_plan.enter_when: Core structure and supported meaning are complete.
information_state_plan.exit_when: Cover plus page volume are readable; repeated rotations and dead tail are removed.
information_state_plan.delete_cost: The distributed proof would not resolve into a complete-product payoff.

information_state_plan.new_understanding: The next step is a non-directional consideration prompt, not a purchase instruction.
information_state_plan.voice_or_caption_job: Use a soft line such as 'What would you want to remember from each school year?' or omit CTA if the target format requires a verified shopping action.
information_state_plan.delete_cost: No direct conversion prompt, but no factual claim is lost.

hero_strategy.job: Resolve the information ladder into one complete album: clean cover plus visible page volume, with the message that the previously shown grade sections live together in this object.
hero_strategy.hold_or_exit_condition: Hold only until cover identity and page volume are understood; exit before repeated rotation stops adding meaning.
hero_strategy.fallback_if_missing: Use S01 as a short identity Hero and end immediately after the supported summary.

cta_strategy.job: Use a soft, non-directional reflection/consideration CTA only after the multi-year structure is proven; do not instruct a click or purchase location.
cta_strategy.hold_or_exit_condition: One short line over a stable Hero; omit if it causes a dead tail.
cta_strategy.fallback_if_missing: End on the benefit-summary Hero without CTA.

fallback.trigger: The early-to-later grade contrast is not simultaneously legible enough, or stakeholders require a stronger emotional/family claim than the sources support.
fallback.replacement_plan: Run a shorter Information + Proof plan: cover identity, visible grade progression, photo/prompt structure, complete-product Hero. Remove the Emotion state rather than filling it with copy.
reshoot_needs: One clean composition showing an early-grade and late-grade spread together
A truthful filled page with authorized photo/details
A parent/child filling or revisiting the album if Emotion primary is desired
Verified offer/UI or natural gesture if a purchase CTA is required

knowledge_application.decision: Open on supported multi-year purchase meaning rather than cover identity alone.
Select Information as primary from purchase motivation and evidence supply; use Emotion only to repair desire, not as an equal lane.
Treat grade progression and prompt types as distinct information states; drop alternate angles and repeated rotations after meaning is exhausted.
Keep emotional value subordinate because no people, completed pages or reactions exist.
Hero summarizes the proven one-album/multiple-years meaning rather than functioning as a decorative ending.
Use non-directional CTA or no CTA because offer and directional evidence are absent.
